text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with a 12-rep field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Time came back.** Reps cut post-call admin from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling time and fresher follow-ups.

**2. CRM data got better.** Next steps and stakeholders were captured consistently, so forecast reviews stopped relying on memory.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated until reps asked consent upfront and explained how notes were used.

**4. Coaching improved.** Managers reviewed real conversations instead of rep summaries.

**5. Not every setting worked.** Noisy job sites and car calls produced messy transcripts.

The takeaway: AI note-takers earn their place when you pair them with clear consent habits and realistic expectations.

What has your team learned from using them?

*(Synthetic scenario; figures are illustrative.)*
